metadata.title: HeritageGraph: Preserving Cultural Heritage and Identity Through Knowledge Graphs
metadata.description: HeritageGraph is a research initiative by CAIR-Nepal that uses AI and Knowledge Graphs to digitally preserve cultural heritage, history, art, and traditions—safeguarding shared identity for future generations.

methods.title: Sources, methods & provenance
methods.intro: HeritageGraph publishes a CIDOC-CRM-aligned knowledge graph. Live mode shows only community-reviewed entities (scope=reviewed) projected from the public Oxigraph partition.
methods.licenseValue: Code: MIT · Curated data: CC BY 4.0
methods.livePipelineBody: Nodes are typed by rdf:type from the LinkML ontology registry; edges are asserted triples between typed resources (not client-side NLP).
methods.liveStep1: Contributions → epistemic review → publication policy gate
methods.liveStep2: RDF projection to graph/public via kg_publish / rdf_rebuild
methods.liveStep4: Relationship edges cite HeritageAssertion provenance when available
methods.demoWarningBody: The frozen demo corpus is for reproducible illustrations. Cite the live reviewed graph for research.
methods.sparqlNote: Query the public partition directly (read-only SPARQL):

hero.description: HeritageGraph is a platform by CAIR-Nepal for digitally preserving and publishing cultural heritage data as Linked Open Data, connecting communities, scholars, and institutions worldwide.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: Cultural heritage is the living memory of humanity—traditions, artifacts, stories, and practices that connect us to our past and guide our future. Yet much of this heritage remains undocumented, fragmented across institutions, or at risk of being lost.
mission.paragraph2: aims to create a comprehensive, interconnected digital archive of cultural heritage using modern knowledge graph technologies. By publishing heritage data as Linked Open Data following CIDOC-CRM standards, we enable researchers, communities, and institutions to discover connections, share knowledge, and preserve cultural memory for future generations.

cair.title: About CAIR-Nepal
cair.subtitle: Center for Artificial Intelligence Research Nepal
cair.description: CAIR-Nepal is a non-profit research organization dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence research and its applications for social good in Nepal and the broader region. HeritageGraph is one of our flagship projects, combining AI, knowledge graphs, and community engagement to preserve cultural heritage.
